eyebrow: From scan to style in days
title: Three simple steps tailored around you
description: Measure once, customize endlessly, and receive your handcrafted outfit, made by the tailor you choose.

steps.title: Measure
steps.description: Use your device to capture your body measurements in about a minute, guided by voice.

steps.title: Pick a design
steps.description: Explore curated designer collections, filter by occasion, fabric, and mood, then customize every detail.

steps.title: Tailored & delivered
steps.description: Your tailor makes it to your measurements. For bespoke pieces you see photos of the finished outfit before it ships, then follow it to your door.
